summary: All four r0 NEEDS_REVISION issues are genuinely resolved against the actual code. ISSUE-1: the typecheck gap is now MANDATORY (was hedged 'possibly'), naming BOTH Assign arms — verified in code that flat (typecheck.rs:1019-1066, RHS@1054-1055) and nested (typecheck.rs:1611-1654, RHS@1642-1643) both compute binding_ty.as_scalar()=None for a CoopMatrix binding and call check_expr(..,None), which raises CoopMatrixBuiltinRequiresExpectedType (2851/2860). The routing fix (check_coopmat_init_expr(tc, &value.node, value.span, matrix_key), signature confirmed at 2604) reaches the coopmat_mul_add validation that enforces c_key.use_==Accumulator (2907) and full K/M/N/elem shape (2916-2958), so AT-1705 positive typechecks and AT-1706 wrong-use_/wrong-shape negatives are genuinely rejected — the routing closes the gap. ISSUE-2: confirmed body.rs:496-503 does unconditional b.store; the mandated coopmat branch is symmetric to the Let coopmat branch (481-484), and since there is exactly ONE HirStmt::Assign handler it covers flat + loop uniformly. ISSUE-3: rspirv 0.12.0 select_block/selected_block/insert_into_block/InsertPoint::Begin(insert at instructions[0], OpLabel is in the separate block.label)/module_mut all confirmed public; the §A.4 exact-ordered-sequence composes correctly against the real emit_for_range CFG (pre_header_label captured before body.rs:753 branch, header idx after begin_block 757, latch=continue_label 805, mandatory select_block(merge_idx) restore at step 10). ISSUE-4: nested-phi composition (outer latch operand == inner loop's exit var_ids[B]=inner_phi_id) is specified and AT-1702 asserts it; break/continue over a loop-carried coopmat is a HARD ERROR (LoopCarriedCoopMatAcrossContinue/BreakUnsupported, AT-1704), enforceable since HirStmt::Break/Continue are distinct variants (body.rs:525/534). OQ-E honesty genuinely de-claims 'competitive': both occurrences in the DESIGN.md payload are de-claiming ('NOT used unless the measured % warrants it'), AT-1710 mandates 'NOT asserted >= any ratio', methodology is bare TFLOPS + % of a labeled 125-TFLOPS datasheet estimate, never a same-machine A/B. The OQ-A scalar-vs-OpPhi split and the OpPhi/CFG mechanism remain CONFIRMED sound. No NEW hole that blocks coding; two minor non-blocking warnings recorded for the Coder.
warnings: WARNING (non-blocking, AT-1706c precision): the spec's AT-1706 sub-case (c) claims `acc = 1.0` (scalar → coopmat target) is rejected via 'CoopMatrixBuiltinRequiresExpectedType / type mismatch'. VERIFIED this is OVERSTATED: when routed through check_coopmat_init_expr, a non-Call expr falls to the `_ => check_expr(tc, expr, span, None)` arm (typecheck.rs:~2772), and a float literal with expected=None type-checks WITHOUT error — there is no final guard that the returned HirExpr's type matches matrix_key. This is a PRE-EXISTING latent gap: the Let coopmat path (1002-1006) has the SAME non-rejection (it adds no post-call type-mismatch guard at 1008-1016), so `let acc: matrix[...] = 1.0;` is already silently accepted today. r1 does NOT introduce this; it inherits it. NOT a blocker for M3.3 (the load-bearing negatives — wrong-use_/wrong-shape coopmat RHS — ARE rejected at 2907-2944). RECOMMEND: the Coder either (a) add an explicit element/type-mismatch guard at the end of check_coopmat_init_expr's `_` and `None`-call arms so a scalar RHS to a coopmat target is rejected (also fixes the latent Let gap), OR (b) downgrade AT-1706c to assert ONLY the wrong-use_/wrong-shape coopmat cases and document the scalar-into-coopmat acceptance as a known pre-existing gap. Do NOT let AT-1706c silently fail and get reverted.

WARNING (non-blocking, ISSUE-4 scan discipline): §A.7 says break/continue over a carried coopmat is rejected by 'detect break/continue HirStmts in the body while a carried coopmat set is non-empty'. The break/continue rejection scan MUST honor the SAME non-descend-into-nested-loop discipline as detect_loop_carried_coopmat (descend_into_nested_loops=false) — an inner ForRange/While's own break/continue (which targets the inner loop's merge/continue, NOT the outer header) is LEGAL and must NOT be rejected by the outer loop's guard. The spec establishes the non-descend pattern for stmt_reassigns_binding but does not explicitly bind the break/continue scan to the same rule. Moot for the shipped matmul/attention (no break/continue at all), but AT-1704's synthetic kernels must reject ONLY a break/continue at the CURRENT loop level over a carried coopmat, not an inner-loop break. Coder note, not a design defect.
